findings: Product-specific insulin concentration engine and UI regression passed on eadbe53cb1ddd561b138e61dd8dda0d7d200ef99.
Canine AAHA insulin instructions need ideal-weight and whole-unit-rounding context; notes now state it.
Removed oral tablet strength metadata from three non-oral furosemide branches.
8d2e22d arithmetic candidate: zero numeric/rendered mismatches. SwiftPM 74/75 passed; stale mixed-route fixture corrected for next run.
Added explicit final-infusion concentration verification in UI and buprenorphine product-specific concentration guards; next CI required.

dc35c0d9967d46a698c2ea8d6398cf331219134d passed arithmetic run 35807452217 and iOS run 35807452287: 90 unit and 9 UI tests; device-target compile passed. Source matching does not establish clinical clearance.

Additional source review confirmed TMP-sulfamethoxazole skin regimens are explicitly present in the antistaphylococcal table; prior search snippets omitted that row. Added canine mirtazapine weight-band enforcement (7 kg source gap intentionally not guessed), and fixed-volume product-concentration engine guard.

Replaced canine commercial cyclosporine drops with a separate ointment-strip dose basis; mass and volume conversions disabled. Corrected ketamine/pregabalin indication wording and removed oral strengths from IV methocarbamol. Weight-band protocols now require weight in view validation even for fixed-mg arithmetic.

Canine doxorubicin >10 kg versus <=10 kg now enforced in both calculators and independently tested. Fenbendazole single-dose and three-day courses separated. Canine praziquantel 170 mg ceiling enforced; weights whose lower range exceeds ceiling require product-table review. Canine pyrantel 5 mg/kg corresponds to Nemex-2 base-dose label; MSD small-dog 10 mg/kg is a distinct alternative, not a universal correction. Credelio dog source and food instruction corrected.

Added direct source checks for anesthesia, seizure, behavior and antiparasitic protocols. Updated propofol/alfaxalone canine induction and midazolam adjunct to named AAHA regimens; narrowed feline paroxetine and sertraline to 2024 AAFP intercat-tension ranges. Feline intranasal midazolam explicitly retains limited-evidence status.

Completed initial source comparison for all 307 entries; this does not mean clinical clearance. Remaining source-limited and protocol-dependent records stay explicitly qualified. Feline cyclophosphamide rescue cycle total is blocked from automatic per-administration calculation to prevent doubling a divided course.

Potassium requires an explicit prescribed infusion rate, maximum 0.5 mEq/kg/hr, and verified final dilution. Ampicillin–sulbactam intermittent entry now explicitly uses combined mass; ambiguous CRI entries are blocked. These are arithmetic safeguards, not clinical clearance.
